name: Skill Graph & MNEMOS Memory
_comment_depends_on: EMPTY, and that is the point: M04 is the root of the graph. Eighteen
modules read it and it reads none of them, so there is no upstream whose
absence can degrade this module - which is what lets it be built, run and
demoed in Phase 1 before M05 or M13 exist.
M13 WRITES here, but that is a caller, not a dependency: episodic writes
arrive through an adapter seam that a fixture can feed (spec §10).
_comment_feeds: These consume M04. Two of the contracts below are already being called by
code that shipped before this module existed, so they are adopted rather
than invented: M15 calls GET /v1/skill-graph/theta today.
Additive changes are safe; renaming or removing a field breaks all of them.

feeds.takes: concept resolution for resume surface forms
theta + SE seed per concept, and the re-test queue as a selection input
the session-pinned profile summary injected at session start
theta per topic, to rank likely questions by the student's own gaps
bottlenecks, trajectories and the re-test queue
the trajectory endpoint, and evidence refs to project the ledger over
